name: PML nuclear body scaffold

function.text: PML encodes protein PML. Annotated molecular activities include transcription coactivator activity and SUMO transferase activity. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Acute promyelocytic leukemia. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Educational atlas reports rearrangement context; exact allele and disease applicability require review.
